403.title: You do not have permission to access this feature.
403.message: If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the system administrator.

404.title: Content Not Found
404.message: The content related to this notification no longer exists or the URL is incorrect.

invalidAccount.title: Account Not Configured
invalidAccount.message: Your account has not been assigned a valid role.
invalidAccount.instruction: Please contact the Admin or system management team to be assigned the correct role.

boundary.title: An error occurred while loading the screen
boundary.message: Please try again or return to the dashboard.

api.CAMPUS_REQUIRED: Please select a campus before signing in.
api.CAMPUS_MISMATCH: Your account does not have access to the selected campus. Please choose the campus you are authorized for.
api.PORTAL_MISMATCH: This account is not allowed to sign in through the current portal. Please check that you are using the right portal.
api.INTERNAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Your account has not been created in the internal system. Please contact your Staff Leader or campus administrator to be granted access.
api.PASSWORD_LOGIN_DISABLED: Password sign-in is disabled. Please use SSO/FEID.
api.ACCOUNT_PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION: This account has not confirmed its email yet. Please check the inbox to confirm before signing in.
api.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Your account is locked. Please try again later or contact an administrator.
api.DEPARTMENT_INACTIVE: Your account's department has been deactivated. Please contact the International Cooperation Department Leader at your campus.
api.CAMPUS_INACTIVE_ACCESS_DENIED: Your campus is currently inactive. Please contact Head Office for assistance.
api.FEID_NOT_CONFIGURED: FEID sign-in is not available yet. Please use another method or contact an administrator.
api.FEID_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Your FEID account is not eligible to sign in. Please contact an administrator.
api.EXTERNAL_AUTH_FAILED: Unable to sign in with this account. Please try again.
api.VISITOR_PROVISION_DISABLED: Automatic Visitor account creation is not enabled.
api.SESSION_REVOKED: Your session has been revoked. Please sign in again.
api.TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
api.UNAUTHORIZED: You need to sign in to continue.
api.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: A system error occurred. Please try again later.
api.STORAGE_FILE_NOT_FOUND: The file could not be opened: it is no longer on Google Drive (deleted, or not shared with the system).
api.STORAGE_FILE_FORBIDDEN: The system is not allowed to read this file on Google Drive. Please ask an administrator to check the sharing permissions.
api.STORAGE_AUTH_FAILED: The Google Drive connection is no longer valid. Please ask an administrator to reconnect it.
api.STORAGE_FILE_REFERENCE_INVALID: This file's record does not point to a valid file. Please upload the file again.
api.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach file storage. Please try again later.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_CONFIG_MISSING: Google Drive is not fully configured. Please contact an administrator.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_NOT_CONNECTED: Google Drive is not connected for this feature. Please contact an administrator.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The Google Drive connection has expired. Please ask an administrator to reconnect it.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED: Could not authenticate with Google Drive. Please try again or check the connection settings.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_NOT_FOUND_OR_NO_PERM: The storage folder was not found, or the account has no access to it.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_UPLOAD_FAILED: The file could not be uploaded to Google Drive.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_UNAVAILABLE: Google Drive is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FILE_URL_MISSING: Google Drive returned no file id after the upload. Please try again.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_LOOKUP_FAILED: The Google Drive folder could not be queried. Please try again later.
api.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_CREATE_FAILED: The Google Drive folder could not be created. Please try again later.
api.EMAIL_ATTACHMENT_UNREADABLE: Cannot send: an attachment's content could not be read. Remove or re-upload the file, then send again. The draft is unchanged.
api.EMAIL_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND: This draft no longer exists or has been deleted.
api.EMAIL_DRAFT_NOT_EDITABLE: This draft has already been sent or discarded, so it cannot be reopened for editing.
api.CAMPUS_MANAGEMENT_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to manage campuses.
api.CAMPUS_ACTIVATION_MASTER_DATA_INCOMPLETE: Cannot activate the campus because required information is missing (code, name, site, address, phone, email).
api.CAMPUS_ACTIVATION_MISSING_IC_DEPARTMENT: Cannot activate the campus because it has no active IC department.
api.CAMPUS_ADDRESS_ALREADY_EXISTS: This address is already used by another campus.
api.CAMPUS_PHONE_ALREADY_EXISTS: This phone number is already used by another campus.
api.CAMPUS_EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already used by another campus.
api.PROFILE_FORBIDDEN_FIELD: The request contains fields that cannot be updated.
api.PROFILE_PHONE_INVALID: Invalid phone number. Please enter 8–15 digits.
api.CONTACT_EMAIL_CANNOT_BE_USED_FOR_VISITOR: This email cannot be used as the delegation contact. Please enter a different email belonging to an external guest or partner.
api.INTERNAL_REGISTRANT_CANNOT_BE_CONTACT: This email cannot be used as the delegation contact. Please enter a different email belonging to an external guest or partner.
api.OPERATIONAL_CONTACT_MUST_BE_EXTERNAL: An internal FPTU account cannot take the delegation contact role. The role belongs to an external guest or partner — please ask the registrant to invite an external email address.
api.REGISTRANT_EMAIL_BELONGS_TO_INTERNAL_ACC: This email cannot be used for the registrant. Please enter a different email belonging to an external guest or partner.
api.VISITOR_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The account linked to this email is not active. Please enter a different email or contact FPTU for support.
api.OTP_INVALID: Incorrect OTP code. Please check and try again.
api.OTP_EXPIRED: The OTP code has expired. Please resend to receive a new one.
api.OTP_NOT_FOUND: Verification session not found. Please submit your request again.
api.OTP_SESSION_INVALID: The verification session is no longer valid. Please resend to receive a new code.
api.OTP_RETRY_LATER: You are going too fast. Please wait a moment and try again.
api.OTP_HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Too many incorrect attempts. Please verify you are human to receive a new code.
api.OTP_RESEND_RATE_LIMITED: You have requested too many verification codes. Please try again later.
api.OTP_SEND_FAILED: Unable to send the OTP code. Please try again later.
api.IMMUTABLE_REGISTRANT_INFO: Registrant information cannot be changed after the request has been submitted.
api.IMMUTABLE_CONTACT_IDENTITY: The contact email, linked account, and contact relationship cannot be changed during this edit.
api.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This submission session is no longer valid. Please close the form and submit again.
api.DUPLICATE_VISIT_REQUEST: A visit request with the same details was submitted recently. No new request has been created.
api.FACE_SCAN_FORBIDDEN: Only the Staff member assigned to this visit may scan and tag faces.
api.FACE_SCAN_CONFIG_INACTIVE: Face detection is currently disabled. Contact an administrator to enable it.
api.FACE_SCAN_PHOTO_NOT_ACTIVE: This photo cannot be scanned (it was removed or could not be read).
api.FACE_SCAN_IN_PROGRESS: This photo is already being scanned — please wait.
api.FACE_SCAN_NOT_CONFIRMABLE: You can only confirm a scan once it has completed successfully.
api.FACE_SCAN_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This scan has already been confirmed.
api.FACE_SCAN_ROW_VERSION_MISMATCH: This scan's data has changed — please reload before confirming.
api.FACE_SCAN_INCOMPLETE_FACE_LIST: Every face in this scan must be resolved (tagged to a guest or marked ignored).
api.FACE_SCAN_DUPLICATE_GUEST: A guest cannot be tagged to two faces in the same scan.
api.FACE_SCAN_GUEST_NOT_IN_INSTANCE: One or more guests do not belong to this exact visit's delegation.
api.FACE_SCAN_INVALID_FACE_ITEM: Each face must be tagged to a guest or marked ignored.
api.FACE_SCAN_RATE_LIMITED: You're scanning too quickly. Please try again in a few minutes.
api.FACE_SCAN_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The monthly face-scan quota has been reached.
api.IMMUTABLE_CONTACT_PROFILE: Operational-contact details cannot be edited in the registration form. Use “Edit the contact” on the request detail screen.
api.OPERATIONAL_CONTACT_PROFILE_NO_CHANGES: Nothing has changed in the operational contact, so there is nothing to save.
api.OPERATIONAL_CONTACT_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRE: This invitation is missing the operational contact's organization. Please ask the registrant to update the contact's details and send a new confirmation invitation.
api.OPERATIONAL_CONTACT_RELATION_NOT_EDITABL: The contact link cannot be changed in Pending Edit. Use Quick Edit to update the link, or Transfer Contact to hand this campus to someone else.
api.OPERATIONAL_CONTACT_LINKED_PROFILE_REQUI: This contact is currently linked to a delegation member. Update that member's details via Pending Edit/Amendment, or unlink the contact if they are no longer part of the delegation.
api.OPERATIONAL_CONTACT_STALE_SESSION_REQUIR: Your editing session is out of date. Please reload the page and try again.
api.AMENDMENT_LEGACY_CONTACT_RELATION_REQUIR: This proposal was created under an older contact-link rule set and must be resubmitted.
